translations.web: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
translations.bsb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
translations.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
translations.asv: For to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call unto him.
